# Purpose
The provided YAML configuration file is a GitHub Actions workflow designed for automating the deployment of backend operations when changes are pushed to the "ops" branch of a repository. The workflow is named "Backend Ops Deployment" and can also be triggered manually via the GitHub Actions tab. It ensures concurrency by grouping jobs and canceling any in-progress jobs if a new one is initiated. The workflow sets permissions for writing ID tokens and reading contents, and it defines a job named "ops" that runs on the latest Ubuntu environment. The job includes steps to check out the code, set up Node.js and Python environments, install dependencies using Poetry, configure AWS credentials, and deploy using the AWS CDK without requiring approval. The configuration is tailored for the "ops" environment, with a note indicating that it currently uses the development environment for Modal, suggesting that further environment-specific configurations might be considered in the future.
